title: Detailed envelope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- envelope body -->
  <rect x='10' y='28' width='80' height='50' rx='4' fill='#f5f0e0' stroke='#d4c9a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- bottom triangle flap shadow -->
  <polygon points='10,78 50,52 90,78' fill='#d9d0b8'/>
  <!-- bottom triangle flap -->
  <polygon points='10,78 50,52 90,78' fill='#e8dfc8' stroke='#c8bb98' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- left triangle flap -->
  <polygon points='10,28 10,78 42,56' fill='#ede5d0' stroke='#cfc4a5' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- right triangle flap -->
  <polygon points='90,28 90,78 58,56' fill='#ede5d0' stroke='#cfc4a5' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- top triangle flap (sealed, pointing down) -->
  <polygon points='10,28 90,28 50,58' fill='#f7f3e5' stroke='#d4c9a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- crease lines on flaps -->
  <line x1='10' y1='28' x2='42' y2='56' stroke='#d8cfb5' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='90' y1='28' x2='58' y2='56' stroke='#d8cfb5' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- top flap edge highlight -->
  <polyline points='12,30 50,57 88,30' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' stroke-opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- wax seal -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='7' fill='#d44a3a' stroke='#b03628' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='5' fill='#e05a48'/>
  <!-- seal emblem -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='3' fill='#c03a2a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#f08878'/>
  <!-- stamp top right -->
  <rect x='68' y='33' width='16' height='20' rx='1' fill='#4a8ec4' stroke='#d4c9a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- stamp perforation dots -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='33' r='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='33' r='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='33' r='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='53' r='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='53' r='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='53' r='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='37' r='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='44' r='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='50' r='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='37' r='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='44' r='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='50' r='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <!-- stamp design: little star/sun -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='43' r='4' fill='#f0c040'/>
  <polygon points='76,36 77.5,41 83,41 78.5,44.5 80,50 76,46.5 72,50 73.5,44.5 69,41 74.5,41' fill='#f7e060'/>
  <!-- address lines -->
  <line x1='20' y1='68' x2='45' y2='68' stroke='#a89a78' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='20' y1='73' x2='40' y2='73' stroke='#a89a78' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='20' y1='78' x2='35' y2='78' stroke='#a89a78' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- return address lines -->
  <line x1='16' y1='36' x2='30' y2='36' stroke='#b8ab8a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='16' y1='40' x2='26' y2='40' stroke='#b8ab8a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- envelope bottom shadow -->
  <rect x='10' y='76' width='80' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#c8bb98' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
